ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in focal clusters and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discrete high-contrast white punctate clusters across both lobes; high density of contiguous white pixels at the distal tips; isolated circular ring features on the left mid-lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 100-110 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 3 to 10 pixels; peaks are more pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature on the trailing edges; the left lobe shows a slightly more vertical distal sweep compared to the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular clusters (rosettes) localized on the outer margins and scattered across the central dark field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned horizontal high-intensity linear marks located centrally below the median notch; several fine-grain linear disruptions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular surface texture at the distal tips; prominent white horizontal scar just below the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique circular white ring-like scar (annular pattern) on the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.
